DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSES OF URINARY TRACT CALCULI
Differential Diagnoses
- Acute pyelonephritis
- Renal tumour
- Acute appendicitis
- Other causes of urinary obstruction e.g. enlarged prostate, urethral
strictures
